offers_products.reason: Cultivates and sells cannabis products (flower, vapes, edibles) under its own brands and through its dispensaries.

offers_services.reason: Revenue comes from selling cannabis goods; retail dispensary operation is product sales, not work done for customers.

sells_to_consumers.reason: Dispensaries serve medical patients and recreational adult consumers directly.

sells_to_organizations.reason: Wholesale segment sells cannabis products to other third-party dispensaries; smaller than retail.

recurring_revenue.reason: Patients and consumers repeatedly purchase consumable cannabis products from its dispensaries.

cyclical_demand.reason: Consumable cannabis, with medical patients, is a habitual purchase and fairly resilient in downturns.

big_ticket.reason: Dispensary purchases are small, frequent consumable buys.

people_delivered.reason: Customers pay for cannabis goods, not staff time; it is a cultivator, manufacturer and retailer.

large_customers.reason: Main buyers are individual patients and consumers; wholesale buyers are other dispensaries.

asset_heavy.reason: Operates cultivation facilities, processing plants and many retail dispensary sites that need ongoing capital investment.
